notes.title: New map and new mode!
notes.content:
Hello! Today we updated the client to version 46 804.
With this update, a new map and a new mode will be added to CityBattle!
● “Delivery” mode on the “Terminal” map.
Players are divided into 4 teams of 3 players each and fight to capture cargo containers. The goal of the mission is to bring as many containers as possible to your delivery points. You can take away someone else’s cargo container by destroying the enemy robot carrying it. Then pick the cargo up and bring it to your delivery point. Two teams with the most cargo containers collected by the end of the match - win.
*The “Delivery” mode/map will be available only in the Rating Game for now.

Hello! Today we have updated the client to version 42 224.
The update has the following changes:

● NEW MODE: Escort
- It takes place on the new map "Railway".
- Mission goal is to:
Defense team: accompany the train to travel as far as possible per round.
Attack team: to prevent defenders from moving the train.
- The speed of the train depends on the number of allies and opponents near it.
- The winner is determined by the distance traveled by trains in two rounds.

In order to make the fights more intense and dynamic, we added special amplifiers to various points on the level.
Amplifier works for 30 seconds and gives to the player:
- A + 25% damage to weapons and abilities
- A 50% repair and a 50% bonus to max durability of the robot
* The amplifier is dropped upon destruction and can be picked up again. The amplification time is not reset, but continues to run.

● Optimization
- Improved game optimization.

notes.title: CHRISTMAS PATCH ALREADY IN THE GAME!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30157259/37d69e2efda21c027f7a0f01ee4ef4919e2cce16.jpg[/img]

On the eve of the Christmas holidays, we tried very hard to please you with updates in CityBattle! First of all, we are glad to announce that a new enthralling mode has been added to the game and a new map where you can try it out!

[b]NEW MODE: Team Deathmatch (TDM)[/b]

It takes place on the new map “Robotics Factory”, which was inspired by DM6 from Quake III Arena.
For each destruction of the enemy team's robot, your team gets 1 point.
The winning team is the first to score 45/75 points (in 3x3 and 5x5 modes, respectively)

In order to make the fights more intense and dynamic, we added a special amplifier, which periodically appears on one of the points of the level. The player who picks it, receives + 25% damage to weapons and abilities for 30 seconds. In addition, the amplifier recovers 50% of the current strength and increases maximum strength by 50%! When a robot with the amplifier is destroyed, the robot it drops it and can be picked up again. The amplifiers’ lifetime is not reset, but continues to run on.


[b]WINTER IS COMING to CityBattle! GIFTS WAIT YOU![/b]

Along with the update in the CityBattle the Christmas mood has settled!
Holidays are approaching, so plunge into the atmosphere of winter with us!
Winter scenery, snowmen and frosty patterns - all this is already waiting for you in the game.

And what’s a Christmas without gifts? Everyone who enters the game from December 27 to January 7 inclusive will receive a Premium Status week and a month of Limit Increase!

[b]GAME OPTIMIZATION[/b]

We regularly work on optimizing the game so that it works well even on weak PCs and as many people as possible can take part in the battles! This even applies to the size of the game - we try to reduce it with each large patch, so that the game does not take up too much disk space on your PC.

Note: If the game spends too much RAM in the main menu, we recommend setting the FPS limit in the settings. Do not judge the performance of the game before the match.

We will be grateful if you share with us information about how the game behaves on your PC. Especially if we are talking about computers with weak components! Contact us through Discord, the link is in the main menu of the game.

[b]BATTLE MODES[/b]

CityBattle has increased the number of maps and game modes. In this regard, we analyzed the modes in which the players are most involved, depending on their level of training. According to the results, it was decided to leave only TDM mode in the Quick Match mode.

At the moment, this mode is implemented only on the new map “Robotics Factory”, but in early 2019 it will also appear on the already existing maps “Communication Tower” and “Power Plant”, and on the new map “Transport hub”, which we will also add to the game at the very beginning of the new year.


The Quick Game mode we consider as an opportunity for players to play for their pleasure, relax, test different game options. While “Rating Game” we are positioning as a competition for experienced players. Therefore, all complex command formats will appear in it, and in the “Quick Game” - only TDM.


[b]TEST YOUR STRENGTH IN WEEKLY COMPETITIONS:[/b]

We remind you that Championships take place every Saturday in CityBattle, anyone from level 10 up can participate in them!

Every first Saturday of the month the prize fund is 85 thousand rubles. (from level 19, 5x5)
All other Saturdays of the month, the prize fund is 19,800 VMoney (from level 10, 3x3)

Also, new stunning skins in the style of steampunk and various original colors of robots are awaiting you! They are already available in the game store, which is updated daily.


[b]OUR PLANS FOR THE FIRST HALF OF 2019:[/b]

1-2 completely new class of robots
3-4 new maps
5-6 new game modes
Voice chat
Social functions will greatly expand (the ability to assemble teams, organize parties, etc.)
The championship system will be expanded so that everyone can compete. We are striving to make e-sports accessible to all and will work a lot in this direction in the coming year.
A new mode “Cargo Accompanying” and a new map for it will be added. In addition, we will try to produce maps and game modes every month, so that there is more variety.
All leagues that we have planned will be opened.

From the start of the OBT, the rating system was in test mode, which came to an end. Therefore, with the beginning of the new year, it will be reset and everyone will be able to start taking their places in the rating again. In the new year we will add rating seasons - once a month the champions will be determined in the game and, at the end of the season, prizes will be awarded to them.

We hope that you liked what we had to share with you! Leave your comments, they are always welcome.

We are waiting for you in CityBattle!

notes.title: Servers off for patch installation
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/10Z6rGn.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends!

This Closed Beta is one of the longest in the history of CityBattle. So it was during this test that the players came across significant difference in levels, sometimes within one match. Even though the matchmaker correctly distributes levels between teams (for instance lvl 50, 7, 1, 1, 1 vs. 45, 12, 1, 2, 1), a low-level player simply won't have the resources to put against a levelled robot. 

To ensure comfortable experience for all the players, we decided to install a patch making the following changes:

1. All players lvl 20 and up shall become lvl 20.
2. All players lvl 1 through 19, shall also become lvl 20.
3. All new players who join the game for the first time after the patch shall get a lvl 20 account.

For new accounts, we have also made it easier to navigate through all the details and are offering robots with pre-installed upgrades - although of course you can change it all to your liking. Join the game as a leveled character and show everyone your skill!

To ensure equal conditions for all the participants of Closed Beta, the levels will be temporarily frozen. But not to worry - all the League and Ranking progress shall be saved, and leveling shall be simultaneous for all the players, in the next few patches.

Surely this is not the only thing we are working on. Next week we shall install another update with multiple balance corrections and bug fixes, based on your feedback. Thanks to everyone who finds time to tell us about errors in game and help us improve it before the Open Beta!

The update was installed at 10.30. The servers should be back on at around 11.00 Moscow time.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m7n6zLw.jpg[/img]

The FINAL closed Beta Test of CityBattle: Virtual Earth has started!

What's new?

1. Following your multiple requests, we have modified the Warmup, which now works in the Free-For-All mode! Unlike the previous test, the Warmup will now take place on both maps, which will be altered to suit this mode: no turrets, no generators, no doors at respawn points etc. Just the hardcore drive!
2. The ranking system was enriched with LEAGUES. Now by gaining personal ranking points, players will move through six Leagues, from the Starting League to the Great Pilots League.
3. CityManagement is arriving! At this stage, no additional in-game functions will be available for the Government. However, we shall introduce external technical media, such as Discord channels where we shall discuss the development and goals of the project, give out special quests, disclose insider information and ask for your opinion on which direction the project should go. In future, the Republican government will manage their territories, fill the Youtube channels of their republics with contents and recruit new citizens. As of now, this function is only available for Russia and former USSR.
4. Optimization is a cornerstone of all patch notes. What exactly did we do?

- The textures now require much less video memory, especially at low graph settings, normally used by the owners of weaker computers.
- GPU optimization: Lighting reworked, effects optimized for low- and middle-end video cards. LODs added for many objects (this means at larger distances we reduce the number of polygons in objects, which reduces the workload on the computer without affecting the game visuals.
- CPU: general optimization of the game logic.
The expected performance growth on weak computers, especially on weaker video cards, shall be 30-80%; for better machines – 20-50%. Generally, FPS will be more even.
5. The sounds have become more informative: we have significantly reworked the sound positioning, added sounds of hits on your robot and enemy robots. Renewed the sounds of shots and reloading for various types of weapons, as well as sounds of class abilities.
6. We rewrote the AI for the new destroyers: they now fly around the generator, without standing still, like it was with the old models.

The test will last until the end of day on April 1st.

notes.title: CLOSED BETA STARTING THIS WEEK!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rNfZFDJ.jpg[/img]

The new combat level is waiting for the heavy steps of the iron soldiers. 
The shiny new details and chips are ready for installation.
The quiet hum of the deadly “flowers” of the destroyers are fully prepared for battle.
And the Invite to Group button is glowing in the interface.

That means we are inviting everyone for the next round of Closed Beta Test, which will start [b]this Friday, on February 9th, at 5 p.m. Moscow time[/b], and last [b]until 11 p.m. on Sunday, February 11th[/b].

[h1]The new map and combat mode[/h1]
The new map called Communication Center is a symmetrical large sized map. On both sides of it, at equal distances from each team, data carriers spawn. Pick up and hold these data carriers to gain points and stay close to the center of the map to earn double points! The first team to earn 500 points wins. Communication Center is intended for intense PvP battles, with less spots to hide away. 

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[olist]
[*]For the first time, the players will level their abilities and weapons using details, improve the basic characteristics using chips and save the results. Such loadouts allow for maximum adaptability to combat tasks, given that you can change classes and loadouts right in the middle of a match.
[*]Playing in groups is now available. You can invite your friends from Steam to join your groups and fight together.
[*]The new Profile displays the following info:
[list]
[*]Current progress, ranking, residence;
[*]Achievements and awards;
[*]Combat history (map, results, timing etc.)
[*]Statistics: deaths vs. kills, damage, win rate etc., with class filter to be added later on.[/list]
[*]New animations for the Assault class. Now this robot moves, runs and aims more naturally, increasing your “presence effect”.
[*]Based on the results of the previous tests, we adjusted some parameters for certain classes:
[list]
[*]The Guard’s Shockwave requiring lots of skill and timing now pays off with more damage. The visual effect now shows the effective radius more precisely.
[*]The Guard’s Second Chance: visuals now reflect the current Power level and the Guard’s invulnerability after the skill activation.
[*]The Tech’s Shotgun now has more scatter. Visual effects were added for repairing rays.
[*]The Assault’s Avalanche: the primary mode damage increased.
[*]and much more…[/list]
[*]We fully updated voice announcements and partially integrated the new sound system focused on sounds of enemy actions, the main source of danger for the player.
[*]New combat interface. Now players see icons of allies and enemies, contours of robots and places of allies’ deaths.
[*]New system of damage indication now clearly shows the damage dealt and received. A special arrow now shows where the damage came from.
[*]Match results screen is updated, now showing robots and combat statistics.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rNfZFDJ.jpg[/img]

The new combat level is waiting for the heavy steps of the iron soldiers. 
The shiny new details and chips are ready for installation.
The quiet hum of the deadly “flowers” of the destroyers are fully prepared for battle.
And the Invite to Group button is glowing in the interface.

That means we are inviting everyone for the next round of Closed Beta Test, which will start [b]this Friday, on February 9th, at 5 p.m. Moscow time[/b], and last [b]until 11 p.m. on Sunday, February 11th[/b].

[h1]The new map and combat mode[/h1]
The new map called Communication Center is a symmetrical large sized map. On both sides of it, at equal distances from each team, data carriers spawn. Pick up and hold these data carriers to gain points and stay close to the center of the map to earn double points! The first team to earn 500 points wins. Communication Center is intended for intense PvP battles, with less spots to hide away. 

[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[olist]
[*]For the first time, the players will level their abilities and weapons using details, improve the basic characteristics using chips and save the results. Such loadouts allow for maximum adaptability to combat tasks, given that you can change classes and loadouts right in the middle of a match.
[*]Playing in groups is now available. You can invite your friends from Steam to join your groups and fight together.
[*]The new Profile displays the following info:
[list]
[*]Current progress, ranking, residence;
[*]Achievements and awards;
[*]Combat history (map, results, timing etc.)
[*]Statistics: deaths vs. kills, damage, win rate etc., with class filter to be added later on.[/list]
[*]New animations for the Assault class. Now this robot moves, runs and aims more naturally, increasing your “presence effect”.
[*]Based on the results of the previous tests, we adjusted some parameters for certain classes:
[list]
[*]The Guard’s Shockwave requiring lots of skill and timing now pays off with more damage. The visual effect now shows the effective radius more precisely.
[*]The Guard’s Second Chance: visuals now reflect the current Power level and the Guard’s invulnerability after the skill activation.
[*]The Tech’s Shotgun now has more scatter. Visual effects were added for repairing rays.
[*]The Assault’s Avalanche: the primary mode damage increased.
[*]and much more…[/list]
[*]We fully updated voice announcements and partially integrated the new sound system focused on sounds of enemy actions, the main source of danger for the player.
[*]New combat interface. Now players see icons of allies and enemies, contours of robots and places of allies’ deaths.
[*]New system of damage indication now clearly shows the damage dealt and received. A special arrow now shows where the damage came from.
[*]Match results screen is updated, now showing robots and combat statistics.
[*]New destroyer models will appear after control points capture at Power Station.
[*]New animations for first-person shooting and impacts on enemy robots will make the combat picture more believable.
[*]All the participants of the previous tests will notice better optimization; expect 10 to 20 FPS increase! [/olist]
